remarks: A wonderful opportunity to live on the water in the sought after Gregory Point Community. The complex offers well manicured grounds including a pool and a clubhouse. This 2 bedroom 1 1/2 bath ranch unit includes a slider off the living room to deck with partial water views of Norwalk Harbor where you can enjoy the outdoors from your balcony. Kitchen has ample storage and has been updated. The master bedroom includes 1/2 bath and partial views of the Harbor.  Additional features are Laundry in unit, abundant closet space, separate private storage space, inground pool, and clubhouse. This complex is located at the end of Gregory Boulevard in the Marvin beach community. Its the perfect neighborhood to enjoy the beauty of the Norwalk Harbor and shoreline! Only a 10 minute walk to Calf Pasture Beach and Ludlow Park and 2 miles to East Norwalk Train Station, I-95, and Sono
